description: This Java class defines constants and utility methods related to authentication, including SASL mechanisms, token handling, and parsing functions for distinguished names and SASL responses.

classes.name: AuthenticationConstants
classes.description: A final utility class containing constants and static methods for handling authentication-related data and operations.

methods.name: getAuthenticationRequest
methods.description: Creates a JSON message for client authentication using specified SASL mechanism and response bytes.

methods.name: getAuthenticationReply
methods.description: Creates a JSON message containing a JWT token for successful client authentication.

methods.name: getCommonName
methods.description: Extracts the Common Name (CN) from a distinguished name string.

methods.name: parseSaslResponse
methods.description: Parses a SASL PLAIN mechanism response byte array into its constituent parts: authzid, authcid, and password.
